biomass_persistence_days.notes: The MVP represents bacterial biomass as a field; individual-cell lifespan is not a runtime parameter.

body_mass.summary: Represented as bacterial biomass carbon/nutrients, not discrete cells.

water_dependence.summary: Common soil bacterium; system-level moisture response is intentionally coarse.

thermal_response.summary: A cellulolytic environmental isolate showed maximum assayed activity at 32 C; this is strain- and assay-specific and not a universal B. subtilis optimum.

cellulolytic_assay_peak_temperature_c.notes: Temperature of maximum cellulolytic activity for one environmental isolate in the cited assay; not a species optimum.

decomposition_rate_system.notes: Shared decomposer-system rate; not a measured B. subtilis rate.

microbial_turnover_rate_system.notes: Approximate 20-day system turnover; not a measured B. subtilis biomass turnover.

notes: B. subtilis is an explicit bacterial decomposer proxy, not a claim that one species represents the full bacterial community.
CUE/turnover validation should target emergent decomposer-system behavior.

cell_length_um.notes: Individual cell geometry is not currently needed by the biomass-field representation.

render.coloration: Not rendered as visible individual cells at terrarium scale.
stage_differences: Biomass field only; endospores are not a separate MVP render stage.
reference_images_asset_notes: Represent indirectly through substrate/biofilm state; microscopic cell art is optional educational detail, not simulation state.

sources.citation: Classical soil/ecology literature on Bacillus subtilis association with soil organic matter.
Wita et al. (2019), cellulolytic activity of an environmental Bacillus subtilis isolate.
Pold et al. (2020), microbial carbon-use-efficiency proxy; not B. subtilis-specific.
